legacyV1.rule: Version 1 remains byte-for-byte legacy reader evidence. A version 1 Retake request or row is never upgraded, rewritten, or executed as version 2 Edit.

compatibility.unknownMalformedFuture: preserve every compatible unknown field and keep the whole row reader-only protected; prohibit enqueue, claim, retry, cancel, reorder, output deletion, staging deletion, publish, and execution
compatibility.mixedVersion: reject a version 2 request that carries a version 1 discriminator or field shape
compatibility.futureBackends: Any additional editor is advertised by a separate exact backend capability and receipt without changing the semantic Edit request; Qwen-Video-Edit and JoyAI-Video-Edit are future-only.

sharedOnly: source selector and bounded source pinning
Jobs, idempotency, durable inbox, queue, output-root, and lifecycle infrastructure
featureIsolation.editOwns: Edit request schema, compiler, seed, timeline mapping, child-clip delivery, backend candidates, capability, receipts, and canaries
featureIsolation.finishOwns: Finish request schema, semantic mode and scale mapping, full-video delivery, backend candidates, capability, receipts, and canaries
featureIsolation.nonAiTrim: The exact frame-selection UI may be reused only by a separately versioned non-AI trim/export operation. Non-AI trim is not an Edit or Finish kind, and its writer, output, and audio-boundary semantics are never inferred from Video Tools v2 readiness.
featureIsolation.rule: Edit and Finish are separate product operations inside the video Job family. Readiness or a receipt for either never enables, validates, retries, or executes the other.

request.sourceIdMeaning: stable gallery or dropped-item identity for presentation and audit; it is never filesystem authority

managed-video-job.sourceVideoJobIdPattern: case-insensitive UUID with 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal groups or exactly 32 hexadecimal characters
managed-video-job.authority: one succeeded exact managed Videos producer resolved by the Companion after the explicit action

displayed-file.path: one non-empty bounded canonical Windows path naming the exact current single dropped or displayed regular video; untrusted request input only
displayed-file.size: captured regular-file byte length, integer 1 through 536870912
displayed-file.mtimeMs: captured finite safe-integer last-write time in Unix milliseconds
displayed-file.binding: WPF may bind and measure the selector through one no-delete/read lease on the exact current single displayed video only during the explicit authenticated preview-probe, prompt-compiler, or Start action. Only the final Start revalidation may publish the selector; navigation, passive view, text or selection changes, skip-review toggles, health, and Jobs reads never construct, resolve, open, or hash it.
displayed-file.companionRevalidation: After the committed inbox item is claimed, Companion canonicalizes and remeasures the opened source and requires exact path, size, mtimeMs, and SHA-256 equality before staging. Replacement or drift returns an authenticated definitive 4xx, creates no Job or output, and leaves the envelope in needs-action under the durable inbox contract.

selection.timeline: zero-based source frames on the probed exact rational source timeline
selection.bounds: 0 <= startFrame < endFrameExclusive <= probed source frameCount; exact selected duration is positive and <= 5000 milliseconds; selected frame count is <= 300

instructionJa.meaning: one user-authored Japanese instruction describing what should change and what should remain
instructionJa.validation: trimmed, well-formed UTF-16, 1 through 4000 code units, no internal command language or reserved control token

compiled.backendPrompt: trimmed, well-formed UTF-16, 1 through 8000 code units, validated for the currently advertised candidate compiler revision
compiled.summaryJa: trimmed, well-formed UTF-16 Japanese summary, 1 through 2000 code units
compiled.compilerRevision: one advertised stable compiler revision of 1 through 128 ASCII characters
compiled.contextDigest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters binding the exact captured or managed source selector identity, selected preview-frame identities, instructionJa, compiled texts, and compiler revision
compiled.serverValidation: WPF validates the bounded shape before inbox publication. After dispatch, Companion revalidates every compiled field and exact context digest before Job commit or execution; it never trusts client compilation. A definitive rejection follows durable inbox needs-action semantics.

strength.meaning: higher values permit a larger requested visual change; it is not a client-supplied sampler denoise value

edit.reviewSkipPolicy: the UI checkbox that skips a second compiled-prompt confirmation is transient one-shot UI policy. It is not stored in the generation snapshot and authorizes no work until source, compiler, capability, and request validation all pass.

finish.scale4Rule: 4x must be explicitly selected and is rejected when exact multiplication would exceed any output bound; there is no implicit crop, downscale, or fallback to 2x
finish.meaning: AI spatial video super-resolution only. Frame interpolation, frame-rate conversion, and per-frame still-image Enhancement are different operations.

transport.routing: The exact POST route is registered only inside the authenticated loopback Companion dispatch. Unknown paths fail 404 and unsupported methods fail 405 with Allow: POST.
transport.passiveReads: Health and Jobs reads never dispatch this route or bind, open, hash, probe, or decode its source.

previewProbe.displayedFile: required before exact frame controls, prompt compilation, or Start. It binds, canonicalizes, hashes, and probes the current displayed-file through one no-delete/read lease and may decode only the bounded requested thumbnails.
previewProbe.managedVideoJob: may use the producer Job's exact persisted source probe and identity without reopening or reprobing the source; explicit bounded thumbnail extraction remains an action rather than a passive read
previewProbe.response: one transient exact source summary plus exactly three ordered start/middle/end displayable PNG payloads under previews; it is not a request, Job snapshot, retry authority, or readiness receipt

thumbnail.base64: canonical RFC 4648 base64 only, with no data-URL prefix
thumbnail.encodedSha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact encoded PNG bytes and separate from decodedPixelSha256
thumbnail.decodedPixelIdentity: decodedPixelSha256 remains lowercase SHA-256 of the exact full-resolution source-frame RGB24 bytes before thumbnail scaling or PNG encoding
thumbnail.runtime: Use only the existing exactly pinned FFmpeg/FFprobe runtime through a direct owned process with shell=false, bounded timeout/cancel/stdout/stderr, verifier-owned scratch cleanup, and no fallback binary.
thumbnail.sourceLease: The no-delete/read source lease, opened-handle pre/post source SHA-256 checks, exact tool re-resolution, and scratch cleanup cover both full RGB24 identity decoding and bounded PNG extraction.

previewProbe.gate: For displayed-file, frame controls, prompt compilation, and Start stay disabled until the current source identity has one valid non-stale preview-probe response. Source identity drift clears it and disables them again.
previewProbe.fpsRule: Use only the exact rational fps and frame count from the bounded media probe. Never assume 24 fps or derive frame count from MediaElement position, natural duration, rounded milliseconds, or UI playback state.

previewIdentities.identityRule: Each role is retained even when a one- or two-frame selection maps more than one role to the same source frame. SHA-256 is lowercase hexadecimal over the exact bounded decoded preview pixels under the persisted transient decoder revision.

candidate.contextDigestBinding: the exact source selector identity, selection, ordered start/middle/end preview identities, instructionJa, compiled texts, and compiler revision
candidate.staleBehavior: clear or visibly mark the candidate unusable; a stale candidate cannot be reviewed, started, published, retried, or silently recompiled

promptCompiler.reviewUnchecked: A successful compile displays the backend prompt and Japanese summary and sends the completion notification. It creates no Job or inbox item; the user must perform a separate explicit Start.
promptCompiler.reviewSkipChecked: Changing the checkbox is passive. Clicking the explicit prompt-compiler action while it is checked grants one transient single-use authorization for compile, final source/context/capability/request revalidation, and then durable Start publication. A compiler response by itself never authorizes or performs publication, and failure consumes the one-shot without enqueueing.
promptCompiler.startRevalidation: Before either the later explicit Start or the checked one-shot continuation publishes anything, WPF recaptures the same source identity through a no-delete/read lease, regenerates the exact preview identities, and requires the same non-stale contextDigest and current compiler/capability result. Drift or mismatch fails with no durable inbox publication, Job, wake, staging, or output.
promptCompiler.passive: Opening or hydrating the board, editing instructionJa, changing selection, seeking preview, toggling review-skip, and reading health or Jobs never bind, canonicalize, open, hash, probe, decode compiler previews, invoke the compiler, create a Job, publish an inbox item, or wake work.

source.unsupported: WPF rejects known request/captured-file bound failures before inbox publication. Companion probe or identity rejection after dispatch is a definitive 4xx needs-action result with no Job, process, or output. Never coerce container, streams, fps, dimensions, duration, or frame count.

managed-video-job.requiredOwnership: one exact canonical regular managed Videos output inside the current configured Enhancement output root
managed-video-job.dependency: reserve the exact producer job and output before the child Job or committed inbox item becomes visible

displayed-file.scope: the exact current single dropped or displayed regular video selected at the explicit action
displayed-file.requestCapture: WPF captures canonical path, size, mtimeMs, and SHA-256 through one no-delete/read lease during explicit Start and publishes them only after authenticated capability validation
displayed-file.canonicalization: Companion canonicalizes from its own opened no-delete/no-write lease, rejects reparse or non-regular targets according to the platform boundary, proves the same opened file before and after bounded hash and probe, and requires exact equality with every captured request field
displayed-file.staging: copy through the validated opened handle to a newly allocated job-owned staging file, then independently canonicalize, bound, hash, probe, and pin that staging file before committing the immutable snapshot
displayed-file.retryAuthority: the exact persisted job-owned staging identity; retry never re-resolves the raw client path or silently imports newer external bytes

explicitActionPinOrder: prove authenticated Companion ownership and exact v2 capability
bind the exact current selector and, for displayed-file, capture canonical path, size, mtimeMs, and SHA-256 through a WPF no-delete/read lease
under the existing shared Jobs publication interlock, validate the final bounded request, atomically publish one durable inbox item, then close the WPF source lease
after lock release, send only the authenticated bodyless recovery-aware wake; passive reads never dispatch the item
Companion atomically claims the committed item, revalidates the exact request and source through its own no-delete/no-write lease, and computes the bounded media probe
for displayed-file, create and independently canonicalize, bound, hash, probe, and pin one job-owned staged copy

commit the immutable Job snapshot and idempotency receipt before execution; only that snapshot contains the server-owned canonical source identity, signature, SHA-256, probe, and dependency or staging ownership
on an authenticated definitive validation rejection, create no Job, process, staging residue, or output and move the envelope to needs-action after later valid items are processed
source.persistedIdentity: The committed inbox retains the exact untrusted request selector and fingerprint for durable delivery. Only a successfully committed Job snapshot contains server-owned canonical source and, for displayed-file, staging paths plus exact signature, SHA-256, and bounded probe; no client-supplied path snapshot is accepted as retry or execution authority.
source.probePin: persist and reverify container, dimensions, exact frame count, fps rational, video time base and PTS digest, duration, stream counts, source signature, SHA-256, and exact audio packet identity before execute, retry, child-clip timeline mapping, publish, cancel cleanup, or delete cleanup

videoPtsProbe.sequence: one finite signed 64-bit presentation timestamp for every decoded source frame in presentation order, expressed in the persisted positive rational video time base; missing, duplicate, decreasing, over-bound, or count-mismatched timestamps are unsupported
videoPtsProbe.digestAlgorithm: initialize SHA-256, then append every presentation timestamp as one signed 64-bit big-endian two's-complement integer in presentation order; the lowercase digest is videoPtsSha256
videoPtsProbe.bounds: at most 18000 timestamp entries, 1048576 bytes combined bounded probe metadata, and 30000 milliseconds

audioProbe.coupling: audio is null if and only if audioStreamCount is 0; audio is one exact object if and only if audioStreamCount is 1
audioProbe.packetPayloadDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over each demux-order encoded packet payload length as unsigned 64-bit big-endian followed by the exact packet payload bytes read through the unchanged opened source handle
audioProbe.bounds: all packet offsets and sizes are safe integers wholly inside the unchanged opened source; the entry, packet, total payload, metadata, source-byte, and timeout limits apply together

durableInbox.publication: explicit Start only; WPF atomically publishes the exact bounded create body and request fingerprint before any wake or Companion dispatch
durableInbox.displayedFileItem: bodyJson contains the exact displayed-file request selector path, captured size, mtimeMs, and SHA-256. They are untrusted equality requirements, not a persisted canonical execution snapshot.
durableInbox.managedReservation: WPF pins the exact managed producer and publishes the inbox item while holding the existing shared Jobs writer interlock; the committed pending or processing item reserves that producer under the durable inbox contract
durableInbox.dispatch: Companion claims pending to processing and performs full v2 parser, source, hash, probe, staging, capability, and compiler validation before committing a Job and idempotency receipt
durableInbox.definitiveRejection: authenticated definitive 4xx creates no Job, worker, model process, or managed output; after processing later valid items the envelope moves to needs-action, remains reader-visible, and no longer reserves a managed producer when the durable inbox contract proves the no-Job outcome
durableInbox.needsActionRedelivery: delivery may be tried again only for the same exact captured displayed-file identity and unchanged request fingerprint. Different source bytes require a new explicit Start and new request id; an old committed item is never rewritten to name them.
durableInbox.retryableFailure: transport failure, timeout, supported retryable status, job-store contention, or restart keeps the committed item recoverable under the durable inbox contract and never imports different source bytes
durableInbox.passiveRead: never creates directories, claims or moves envelopes, dispatches requests, canonicalizes or opens a source, stages a file, or mutates inbox or Jobs state

precise-mask.intent: precise source-video editing candidate after an exact spatial mask or auto-mask plus preview contract exists

semantic-v2v.intent: one-Japanese-prompt natural-language and creative source-video editing candidate without a spatial mask request

separateFeatureNames.rule: FL2VA, Ref2VA, and AddGuide are not aliases for source-video Edit and are never silently selected as its backend

canaryOrder: no-download schema, inventory, and synthetic timeline preflight
wan-vace-1.3b-edit-candidate-v1 only after exact mask or auto-mask plus preview contract

checks: exact Comfy object_info and graph input schema
existing local artifact inventory without activation inference
synthetic source-frame, PTS, backend-map, pad, crop, and selected-audio mapper

editBackendCandidates.selectionRule: A paired capability advertises one exact resolved Edit backend and receipts only after source-fidelity, instruction-following, temporal, resource, cancellation, and child-clip output canaries. There is no automatic fallback and the semantic public request remains unchanged.
activationRequires: exact model artifact and runtime receipt
exact Aibos workflow and input schema receipt
exact source-to-backend timeline mapping and output crop receipt
bounded VRAM, timeout, cancellation, cleanup, and recovery canary
non-destructive child-clip timeline, audio, output ownership, and retry canary

editPlan.selectionDuration: derive exactly from the selected half-open source-frame range and persisted rational source fps; duration must be positive and no greater than 5000 milliseconds
planOrder: persist the exact selected half-open source-frame and PTS intent
resolve one exact backend from the current Edit capability
derive and persist the backend-owned frame-rate map, internal frame count, alignment padding, and delivery crop without changing the request
persist the strength mapping, seed, model canvas, exact audio policy plan, workflow/model/runtime receipts, and child-clip delivery plan before execution

serverOwned: delivery crop and source-fps reconstruction revision
backendTimeline.rule: a 16-fps or 4n+1 backend constraint is internal receipt data and never changes the source-frame selection contract

strengthMapping.mappingRevision: one exact backend-specific revision advertised by the current capability and persisted in the immutable plan
strengthMapping.value: one reduced non-negative rational numerator/denominator accepted by the resolved workflow; the mapping is monotonic with requested strength within that backend revision

editPlan.spatialMaskFutureCapability: additive, separately advertised, and never inferred from an unknown request field
editPlan.canvas: derive one source-aspect, no-crop model canvas inside requested maximumPixelArea using the resolved workflow alignment rules and persist it

audioPolicy.preserve: when at least one encoded source audio packet intersects the selected source PTS interval, persist one non-empty half-open source packet range and exact edit-list revision for packet remux; when no packet intersects, persist the preserve-no-packets variant without any packet range
audioPolicy.mute: persist the mute variant and no packet range or packet identity; generated and source audio are both excluded from delivery

editPlan.ui: show the exact selected source range and the resulting child-clip duration; internal backend padding and crop are diagnostics, not a second editable range

editDelivery.timeline: delivery starts at zero and reconstructs exactly the selected source frame count, rational fps, relative PTS sequence, and duration after the persisted internal map and crop
editDelivery.dimensions: the persisted resolved model delivery dimensions; no implicit crop

audio.preserve: remux only a persisted non-empty encoded source packet range intersecting the selected source PTS interval, without re-encoding, and rebase it through the persisted edit-list revision. If no source packet intersects, emit no audio stream and persist no packet range or fabricated identity. No sample-exact trim claim is made.
audio.mute: emit no audio stream. Do not add silence, decode generated audio, preserve source packets, or fabricate a zero-length packet range or hash identity.

editDelivery.boundaryPacketRule: an encoded packet intersecting a selection boundary may decode to samples outside the exact frame-derived interval; this is why preserve makes no sample-exact trim claim
editDelivery.publish: one new managed Videos output and child Job; never modify, replace, or automatically splice into the long source

file.bound: final byte length must be no greater than both hardMaximumBytes and the exact ready capability resourceBounds.maximumOutputBytes

streams.audioCoupling: audio stream count and encoded packet identity must exactly match the persisted discriminated audioDelivery; mute and preserve-empty require zero audio streams

video.frameCount: exactly delivery.frameCount and the selected source frame count
video.fps: exactly delivery.fpsNumerator/delivery.fpsDenominator and the persisted rational source fps

pts.sequence: one finite signed 64-bit presentation timestamp per output frame in presentation order, strictly increasing in one persisted positive rational time base, and exactly equal to the selected source PTS sequence rebased to zero under deliveryMappingReceiptId
pts.digest: compute videoPtsSha256 with the source probe signed-64-bit big-endian algorithm and require exact equality with delivery.videoPtsSha256

audio.preservePackets: codec, codec tag, profile, sample rate, channels, ordered packet payload bytes, and the non-empty source packet range must match the persisted source probe, audioPlan, and audioDelivery; container timestamp rebasing may change packet timestamps but not payload bytes
audio.muteOrEmpty: no audio stream, silence track, zero-range placeholder, or packet identity is allowed

validationAndPublicationOrder: write only to a newly allocated attempt-owned temporary file below the bounded job scratch root
close encoder and process handles, then open that exact regular file through a no-delete/no-write validation lease
prove unchanged identity before and after bounded byte hash, stream probe, frame decode/count, PTS digest, pixel-format check, and audio packet validation
persist the output validator receipt, final SHA-256, byte length, probe digest, and journal transition before publication
atomically publish the same validated bytes to one newly allocated canonical managed Videos path; never overwrite an existing file
reopen and revalidate published identity before marking the Job succeeded
editOutputValidator.failure: any mismatch, timeout, extra stream, unsupported pixel format, byte-bound overflow, ambiguous identity, or journal disagreement keeps the Job non-succeeded, publishes nothing, preserves the source, and cleans only proven attempt-owned temporary artifacts

generative-detail.intent: generative detail restoration candidate that may synthesize texture

lightweight-4x.reportedTemporalShape: bidirectional recurrent with an official T=15 disjoint-chunk demonstration
lightweight-4x.aibosChunkPolicy: one exact overlap-and-crop revision must be advertised and persisted; official disjoint chunks are not accepted as seamless output evidence
lightweight-4x.scale2: unsupported until an exact separately canaried 4x-to-2x delivery mapping is advertised

finishBackendCandidates.modeMapping: No candidate ID implies a public mode or default. Each fast, standard, or quality capability independently resolves and persists an exact backendId, semanticRole, backend setting, supported scales/source bounds, delivery mapping, temporal policy, and receipts after canary.
finishBackendCandidates.selectionRule: The public mode and scale are backend-independent. No mode, semantic role, or backend silently falls back to another, and generative-detail behavior is never substituted for faithful restoration without the exact advertised mode mapping.
activationRequires: exact backend artifact, package or model, runtime, driver/GPU, runner, and API receipt
bounded VRAM, timeout, cancellation, cleanup, and process-ownership canary
frame count, rational fps, PTS, duration, no-crop, and exact source-audio packet canary
scene-cut state reset or recreation A/B canary for every temporal backend
SeedVR2 3B source-fidelity, texture-generation, and bounded-VRAM canary
independent fast, standard, and quality visual A/B canaries

backendMapping.rule: health advertises one exact server-owned mode-to-backend mapping revision and the immutable snapshot persists its resolved backendId and backend setting

finishPlan.exactScale: output width = input width * requested scale and output height = input height * requested scale; reject overflow or any exceeded bound
finishPlan.futureColor: HDR, 10-bit, tone mapping, and color-space conversion require a future additive capability and are unsupported in v2
preserve: exact source encoded audio packets when present
finishPlan.sceneCut: backend temporal-state behavior is not inferred from a model, SDK, or integration description. Production stays closed until a pinned runner proves reset or recreation at detected scene boundaries and persists its detector, threshold, and reset-policy receipts.

requestNormalization.managed-video-job: persist requested.source as kind plus sourceVideoJobId
requestNormalization.displayed-file: persist requested.source as kind only; consume but do not retain the raw untrusted request path as retry authority
requestNormalization.authority: video.source is the server-owned canonical managed or staged identity used by retry and execution

jobEnvelope.common: job.operation and job.mediaKind are video; job.sourceId remains presentation identity; job.presetId is the semantic v2 preset; job.adapterId is the exact resolved server backend; job.presetHash binds the complete immutable video snapshot
jobEnvelope.managed-video-job: job.sourceVideoJobId is required and exactly equals video.source.producerJobId
jobEnvelope.staged-displayed-file: job.sourceVideoJobId is absent; video.source.stagingCanonicalPath and its identity are retry authority

preserve-packets.range: 0 <= packetStartIndex < packetEndIndexExclusive <= persisted source audio packetCount

preserve-no-packets.rule: source has no audio stream or no encoded packet intersects the selected source PTS interval; no packet index, edit-list, or packet identity field is present

mute.rule: no source packet range, edit-list, or packet identity field is present

remuxed-source-packets.rule: audioStreamCount is exactly 1, the source packet range is non-empty and equals the persisted plan, and SHA-256 identifies the ordered encoded payload bytes of that exact range

no-audio-preserve-empty.rule: audioStreamCount is exactly 0 and no packet range or packet identity field is present

no-audio-muted.rule: audioStreamCount is exactly 0 and no packet range, zero-range placeholder, packet identity, or synthesized-silence field is present

persistedSnapshot.seed: Edit uses one server-owned integer from 0 through 2147483647. It is never accepted from a request and exact retry reuses it.
persistedSnapshot.presetHash: recursively sort object keys with ordinal string comparison, serialize compact JSON, SHA-256 UTF-8 bytes, and take the first 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters
persistedSnapshot.unknownOrMalformed: reader-only protected and byte-preserving under the compatibility rule

currentDisabledCompatibility.shape: healthCapability.exactShape.edit remains the exact current disabled variant with no additive ready-only fields
currentDisabledCompatibility.unknownOrMalformed: preserve reader visibility, treat Edit as not ready, and prohibit publication, enqueue, wake, claim, retry, process start, or output mutation

resolvedBackend.rule: The exact model and workflow must consume the selected source video across time as conditioning. Image-to-video, first/last-frame retake, FL2VA, Ref2VA, AddGuide, per-frame I2I, or an unknown backend cannot satisfy this shape. Model and workflow revision strings are non-empty receipt-bound stable identifiers.

receipts.idRule: every receipt ID is a non-empty 1 through 128 character stable ASCII identifier that resolves to one local sealed receipt; no request or health client supplies it
receipts.setDigest: receiptSetSha256 is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters over the exact canonical receipt set and all resolved receipt content digests
receipts.crossBinding: every receipt must bind protocol, capability revision, backend/model/workflow revisions, compiler, timeline and audio delivery revisions, exact resource bounds, output policy revision, runner/platform identity, synthetic fixture revision, and its measured canary result. Missing, stale, contradictory, unresolvable, or differently bound receipts make ready false.

resourceBounds.measuredRuntimeBounds: maximumGpuVramBytes, maximumHostRamBytes, maximumScratchBytes, maximumOutputBytes, processTimeoutMs, and cancelGraceMs are positive safe integers, no larger than independently configured server hard ceilings, and exactly equal to the resource canary receipt; zero, missing, inferred, or uncanaried values are not ready
resourceBounds.plannerRule: the complete request, selected source, planned canvas, scratch estimate, output bound, current free resources, and one-job lease must fit every advertised bound before inbox publication and again before process start; a smaller unknown backend or silent quality fallback is prohibited

outputPolicy.maximumBytesRule: positive safe integer exactly equal to resourceBounds.maximumOutputBytes and no greater than editOutputValidator.file.hardMaximumBytes

ready.activationRule: Exact ready shape is necessary but not sufficient. The authenticated health producer must resolve and rehash every receipt, prove all fixed and runtime bounds, match the exact output policy, hold the paired activation revision, and pass current durable dependency, staging, cancel, recovery, and output-validator checks. Any failure emits the disabled variant rather than a partially ready shape.

editCapabilityVariants.finishIsolation: This Edit shape does not add, reinterpret, or enable any Finish field, mode, backend, receipt, resource bound, or writer. Finish remains the exact current disabled lane.

healthCapability.writerRule: readerReady never authorizes durable publication. Edit requires its exact lane fields. Finish additionally requires the exact requested mode's independent writerEnabled, backendConfigured, runtimeVerified, and ready fields. All must be true under one authenticated current health response, and its supported scales, source bounds, backend/delivery mappings, temporal policy, and receipts must exactly match the request planner. No other mode is a fallback.

durableDependencies.managedActiveJob: producerJobId reserves its exact producer output while the child is queued or running
durableDependencies.managedDurableInbox: a bounded exact committed create or retry item reserves the producer output before the child Job exists
durableDependencies.managedDelete: producer output deletion passively fails closed while an active or committed pending dependency exists

nestedManagedSource.walk: under the shared Jobs publication or mutation lock, follow only exact supported managed source producerJobId edges from the direct producer toward the root; retain a visited-id set and reject a cycle, duplicate edge, missing row, malformed or future row, non-succeeded producer, ownership mismatch, or exceeded bound
nestedManagedSource.durableReservation: before a descendant inbox item becomes visible, persist the exact ordered producer job IDs and canonical output identities in the dependency reservation ledger. Job commit transfers the same closure to the child Job without a gap; retry reuses and revalidates it rather than recomputing from client paths.
nestedManagedSource.deleteGuard: deletion of any producer or ancestor output fails closed while any committed inbox reservation, active descendant Job, retry item, cancel/recovery journal, or publication journal contains that exact dependency identity
nestedManagedSource.release: release one edge or closure only after the descendant row and every retry, cancel, recovery, output, and staging reference are durably absent; partial or ambiguous release preserves all ancestors

durableDependencies.externalStaging: staging is owned only by its Video Tools job and remains available for exact retry while any row, durable item, or recovery journal may refer to it
durableDependencies.externalOriginal: never deleted, moved, overwritten, repaired, or replaced by Aibos
durableDependencies.cleanup: remove only a proven job-owned staging or scratch artifact after all active, durable, retry, cancel, recovery, and publish dependencies are absent; ambiguous identity preserves the artifact and fails closed

displayedStaging.ownership: one staged source belongs to one logical Edit Job, not to an execution attempt. The immutable snapshot binds staging canonical path, size, mtimeMs, SHA-256, probe, owner Job ID, and source identity digest.
displayedStaging.creation: the claimed inbox delivery journal allocates one new bounded staging path, copies only from the already revalidated opened external source handle, independently hashes and probes the closed staged bytes, then atomically commits staging ownership with the Job snapshot
displayedStaging.preCommitFailure: creates no Job. A recovery journal may remove only the exact newly allocated incomplete stage after proving request, path, handle, and byte identity; otherwise it preserves the artifact and reports needs-action.
displayedStaging.retry: reuse the exact committed staged identity and revalidate signature, SHA-256, probe, owner Job ID, and source identity digest. Never reopen the external path, import replacement bytes, or make a per-attempt staging copy.
displayedStaging.cancel: cancel does not delete the external original or guess staging ownership. The stage remains while the Job, a retry action, or any cancel/recovery journal can reference it.
displayedStaging.delete: remove staging only after the terminal Job output and Job row are eligible for deletion, no dependency or retry remains, every attempt journal is terminal, and exact stage ownership is revalidated; failure preserves staging and fails closed

attemptJournal.beforeProcess: persist reserved/source-validated state, exact immutable snapshot hash, source and dependency identities, attempt-owned scratch root, temporary output allocation, current receipt set, and process launch intent before starting any backend process
attemptJournal.processOwnership: after launch, persist a non-reusable process identity bound to attemptId. Cancel and recovery may signal or terminate only that proven process; PID alone is never ownership proof.
attemptJournal.transitionRule: append or replace journal state atomically with the latest on-disk Job under the Jobs mutation authority. Unknown state, missing identity, reversed transition, receipt drift, or conflicting attempt is reader-only and blocks execution, success, cleanup, retry, and delete.
attemptJournal.publication: output-validated state binds the exact validator receipt, output SHA-256, byte length, probe, PTS digest, audio delivery identity, and intended final path before publishing. Succeeded Job state is committed only after published bytes are reopened and matched.
attemptJournal.retention: retain the journal until Job state, idempotency receipt, final output or failure, cancellation, dependency ledger, staging, and scratch cleanup all agree

recoveryInvariants.retry: uses the exact persisted request, plan, seed, source/staging identities, dependency closure, and receipt-compatible backend; creates a new attemptId and new scratch/temp output. It never resumes or publishes an earlier unvalidated temporary output.
recoveryInvariants.cancel: durably records cancel-requested before signalling the proven process, waits only the bounded advertised grace interval, records exit observation, publishes nothing after cancellation, and marks cancelled only after journal and process ownership agree
recoveryInvariants.startupRecovery: reconcile nonterminal journal with current Job and filesystem identities without starting a model or worker during passive health/Jobs reads. Recovery runs only through the authenticated explicit recovery worker and is bounded by exact journal count, path, byte, probe, and time limits.
recoveryInvariants.delete: terminal output and job-owned staging/scratch deletion require exact current hashes/identities, complete journal, no active/retry/recovery/publication reference, and no managed descendant dependency. Partial cleanup never deletes source media or rewrites the Job as repaired.
recoveryInvariants.failure: ambiguous process, output, staging, dependency, or journal ownership preserves data, leaves a reader-visible failure or needs-action state, and fails closed

retry.rule: retry creates one new attempt from the exact snapshot, seed, source/staging identity, dependency closure, and compatible pinned receipt set; it never reuses an earlier scratch or unvalidated output. Source mismatch, missing staging, unsupported capability, incomplete journal, or ambiguous publication keeps the source row and fails closed.

cancel.rule: cancel only a mutation-safe known v2 row through existing authenticated queue ownership and the exact attempt journal; durably record cancel-requested before signalling only the proven attempt process, publish nothing afterward, and preserve source, committed durable state, and unproven process or staging ownership
